$Comment: The Undead foe family: the game's undead and the undead roles outside that group, the ones a foe-family bonus counts on. Bosses and elites never count, so every family excludes the game's boss and encounter groups and their role names (the elite skeleton, the praetorians and the pirate captains among them), and so do the foes as strong as an elite (the Shadow Knight, the two larger Aberrant zombies and the Void Spawn); add a role to ExcludeRoles to take it out too.
